title: Exitwise: Arrow Escape Puzzle Game, Free on Android and Web
description: Tap an arrow and it slides off the board, if nothing is in its way. A free arrow puzzle and logic game with 600 levels in 17 worlds. Play on Android or online.

@graph.name: Exitwise: Arrow Escape Puzzle
@graph.description: Tap an arrow and it slides off the board, but only if nothing is in its way. A free arrow puzzle and logic game with 600 levels in 17 worlds, with bombs, mirrors, portals and more.

art.alt: Exitwise: a tower of colorful worlds rising from a green meadow, through candy land, desert, a volcano and ice to purple crystals, with a glowing door at the top under the title, balloons in a starry sky and a river winding past forests

intro.title: Try the arrow puzzle right here
intro.lede: Tap an arrow and it slides off the board, but only if nothing is in its way. Clear every arrow to win. One tap, one rule, 600 levels in 17 worlds.
intro.caption: Tap an arrow whose path to the edge is clear.

items.name: 1-board
items.caption: Tap an arrow to set it free
items.text: An arrow slides off the board when nothing is in its way. Clear every arrow to win, and mind your hearts: a blocked tap costs one.
items.alt: Level 33 in the Jungle: a zigzag board packed with bendy arrows, with a tap marker on the arrow that leaves first

items.name: 2-map
items.caption: Explore 17 colorful worlds
items.text: One level map runs from the Meadow to Starlight, through jungle, lava, ice, candy and more. Daily puzzles, rankings and friends wait at the top.
items.alt: The level map in Candy land at level 385, with the Daily, Ranking, Friends and Maps buttons

items.name: 3-mirrors
items.caption: Mirrors bend an arrow's path
items.text: An arrow that meets a mirror turns by 90 degrees and keeps going. Plan the bounce before you tap.
items.alt: Level 61 in the Volcano: glass mirrors among the arrows on a dark lava board

items.name: 4-portals
items.caption: Portals carry arrows across
items.text: In one portal, out of its pair, anywhere on the board. This giant board mixes them with mirrors, rocks and bomb arrows.
items.alt: Level 108 in the Lagoon: a pair of portals among mirrors, rocks and bomb arrows on a giant board

items.name: 5-shutters
items.caption: Shutters open as you clear arrows
items.text: A steel roller door hides the arrows under it, even from powerups. Clear enough arrows and it rolls up.
items.alt: Level 221 in the Crystal caves: a steel shutter on a diamond-shaped board

items.name: 6-chain
items.caption: Chain bombs blast whole walls
items.text: Rocks side by side make a wall, and one chain bomb clears all of it. Free the bomb's path first.
items.alt: Level 281 in Clockwork town: a wall of five rocks and its chain bomb

items.name: 7-paint
items.caption: Paint tiles recolor arrows
items.text: An arrow that flies over a paint tile takes its color, ready for the color gate further along.
items.alt: Level 191 in the Autumn woods: paint tiles on a ring-shaped board

items.name: 8-switches
items.caption: Keys open color doors
items.text: The first arrow that flies over a key turns it, and every door of its color swings open at once.
items.alt: Level 311 in Clockwork town: a yellow key and the locked door it opens on a heart-shaped board

link.label: Keys and doors in the wiki

sections.title: Listen to the soundtrack
sections.intro: The music from the game: flute, clarinet, harp and pizzicato strings for the worlds, and a tenser theme for the hard levels. Press play and keep reading; a small player stays with you down the page.

cover.alt: The Exitwise soundtrack cover: the tower of worlds under a starry sky, with the glowing door at its top

items: Find an arrow whose path to the edge is clear.
Tap it, and it snakes off the board.
Every arrow you clear can free others. Keep going until the board is empty.
Mind your hearts: tapping a blocked arrow costs one of three.

sections.title: A new twist every few worlds
sections.intro: From level 21 a new obstacle arrives every 20 to 30 levels and then stays, mixed in with the ones before it. Each one starts on an easy level built to teach it, with a hand that shows you the move.

items.title: Rocks & bombs
items.text: Clear the arrow guarding a bomb's path, then blast its rock.

items.title: Colour gates
items.text: Only their own colour gets through, then they open.

items.title: Mirrors
items.text: Turn an arrow's path by 90 degrees.

items.title: Level-2 rocks
items.text: Two bombs, usually from two sides.

items.title: Portals
items.text: In one, out of its pair, across the board.

items.title: Ice
items.text: Melts as arrows leave. Its number is just enough.

items.title: Level-3 rocks
items.text: The toughest stone: three bomb hits.

items.title: Paint tiles
items.text: Fly over one and take its colour.

items.title: Shutters
items.text: Hide the arrows under them, even from powerups, until they roll up.

items.title: Two-colour gates
items.text: Two colours, and the big symbol goes first.

items.title: Chain bombs & rock walls
items.text: One blast runs along a whole wall.

items.title: Colour switches
items.text: Press one to open every gate of its colour, except two-colour gates.

more.label: Every obstacle and powerup in the wiki →

items.title: Easy to learn
items.text: One tap, one rule.

items.title: 600 levels
items.text: Harder all the way, with a hard level every 10th, from small warm-ups to giant 100×100 brain-teasers.

items.title: Always solvable
items.text: No luck, just logic. Every player gets the same levels.

items.title: Play at your own pace
items.text: Think first, then tap.

items.title: Hints when you're stuck
items.text: Light up an arrow that's free to go.

items.title: Plays offline
items.text: On the commute, on a break, anywhere.

items.title: 17 worlds, 49 shapes
items.text: From Meadow to Starlight on one level map, on boards shaped like hexagons, spirals, rockets and castles.

items.title: Daily challenge
items.text: One new board a day, the same for everyone, with monthly rewards.

items.title: Play with friends
items.text: Race 2 to 8 players on the same boards with a room code.

items.title: Custom maps
items.text: Build your own levels, share them, and play everyone else's.

items.title: Leaderboards
items.text: A board for every level, plus global ranks for score, perfect clears and maps. See the global ranking

items.title: Powerups
items.text: Auto-play, grid lines, remove arrow and the magic wand, for the toughest boards.

cta.title: Your first board is waiting
cta.text: Free on Android and in your browser: 600 levels in 17 worlds, and a new twist every few worlds.
